privileged_info_for_vlm: In OpenEMR, the appointment report is located under 'Reports' -> 'Visits' -> 'Appointments'. The standard date format for input is YYYY-MM-DD. The report must include all providers, so the provider selection should be set to 'All' or left at the default if it encompasses all. The report is only considered 'displayed' if the resulting table of appointments is visible in the browser view.
